clips.title: The story
paras: In Stormwind's Dwarven District, warriors seek Furen Longbeard's skill to forge specialized, battle-ready armor. Apprenticed to Grimand Elmore, the master armorer is known for his metallurgical expertise and heavy protective gear.

Furen Longbeard works far from Ironforge's great forges, among the cobblestones and soot of Stormwind's Dwarven District. Like many dwarves, he brought traditional metallurgy south to help rebuild and defend the kingdom. His work keeps him connected with artisans throughout the city and beyond.

Grimand Elmore taught Furen Longbeard his craft. Furen has perfected ways to treat heavy mail and plate so they can withstand the punishment of battle. Young warriors seeking durable protection turn to him, and he requires rare ores, specialized components, and exotic reagents from distant corners of the world to fashion his signature fire-hardened armor.
